tasks.author: ai-task-writer-a
tasks.prompt: Summarise for a new support engineer who can start a ledger export, what a single export can cover, and what happens when an export takes too long or fails.

rubric.text: Only account owners and Bookkeeper-role users can start an export; support staff can start one for any account from the admin console while impersonating it.
A multi-entity account exports one entity at a time; there is no combined export across entities.
One export covers at most 12 months and 50,000 ledger lines, and an account can start at most 5 exports per hour.
A job not finished after 15 minutes is cancelled, and failed jobs are not retried automatically.
Finished files stay downloadable for 7 days and are then deleted.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Scope, Limits and How an export runs.
